Company: Dufour Aerospace
Title: 3D Concept & Visualization Artist (m/f/d) (Freelance / Working Student)
Location: Dübendorf
Visa: 
About Dufour Dufour provides sovereign, automated aerial logistics capabilities. Transitioning from a UAV developer into a defence-first network provider, we deliver complete, repeatable operating systems – combining automated aircraft fleets, control rooms, training, and support – to keep critical supplies moving when conventional infrastructure is disrupted. The Role We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy 3D Concept & Visualization Artist to bring our new aircraft designs to life through compelling photorealistic and concept renderings. Working closely with our communications team, you will visualize our upcoming aircraft platforms in real-world mission scenarios – while providing clean base renders that enable our team to generate fast variations using AI tools.
